messages:
Maya: Heads up — we're drafting customer-facing copy for the partial regional outage earlier. Need marketing eyes on tone and timing. Posting draft below.

Maya: DRAFT STATUS PAGE COPY (do not publish):
```
We’re investigating increased request errors in EU-West affecting model responses since 09:12 UTC. Engineers are actively restoring capacity; some requests may see higher latency or errors. No data loss. Next update in 30 minutes.
```

Maya: Proposed send window: immediate status page update + emailed note in 30m if degraded persists. Thoughts?

Jen: Thanks. Quick notes — remove 'No data loss' on status page (legal prefers 'no evidence of data loss'). Also suggest adding 'workaround' section if applicable.

Dmitri: Agree with Jen. Proposed tweak:
```
We’re investigating increased request errors in EU-West since 09:12 UTC. Our team is working on restoring capacity; you may see higher latency or intermittent errors. No evidence of data loss at this time. Next update at 09:50 UTC.
```
Dmitri: Also include 'impacted features' list: API generation + embeddings for EU region.

Evan: Support queue is getting pings — recommended we post a canned reply. I'll paste one below.

Evan: Canned reply:
```
Thanks for reporting this. Our engineers are aware and we're working to restore service. Please include your request IDs and region; we’ll follow up in this thread.
```

Maya: Good. Marketing asks for headline that's calm but clear. Options:
- 'Service disruption in EU-West — investigating'
- 'Partial outage in EU-West — working on fix'

Jen: Pick option 1. Also add CTA: 'Subscribe for updates' link to status page.

Sam: @Maya set next update for +20m. We might fallback traffic to other regions if errors spike — I'll flag if we flip routing.

StatusBot: Incident created — INC-2026-349, severity P2. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-349

Maya: OK final copy with adjustments:
```
Headline: Service disruption in EU-West — investigating
Message: We’re investigating increased request errors and higher latency in EU-West that started at 09:12 UTC. Engineers are actively working on restoring capacity. You may experience failed requests or longer response times. No evidence of data loss at this time. Impacted features: Text generation, embeddings (EU region).
ETA/next update: 09:50 UTC.
CTA: Subscribe for updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```

Maya: Can marketing own the push to Twitter + customer email in 30m? Jen?

Jen: Yes — we'll prepare short email and tweet. Email subject: 'Redwood — service disruption in EU-West'. Draft landing in #marketing-drafts in 15m.

Evan: I'll queue support canned reply.

Dmitri: If we trigger cross-region fallback, I'll post an update with 'traffic rerouted to US-West — expect slightly higher latency'.

Maya: Thanks team. Locking copy in 10m unless objections. :thumbsup:
